# Operator console navigation

<!-- Generated by web/scripts/console-navigation.mjs from navigation.js. -->

The workbench defines 7 areas in
`web/src/console/operator/navigation.js`. The engine imports that same table.
An area initially opens its first tab. Session capabilities may hide areas or
tabs; a visible tab alone establishes neither live data nor permission to write.
Unavailable reads and explicit example states retain their own labels.

| Area | Hash | Tabs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Command Center | `#area-command` | Overview, Example fleet, Release Control Tower |
| Packaging | `#area-packaging` | Runs, Timeline, Pipeline, Workspace, Source, Preview, Lifecycle, Bundle, Proposals |
| Releases | `#area-releases` | Environments, Products, Dependencies, Plans, Channels, Waves, Windows, Planning, Ramp, Convergence, Activity, Promotion, Recall |
| Change requests | `#area-changes` | Requests, Approvals, Diff, Constraint gate |
| Intelligence | `#area-intelligence` | Logic, Evals, Courses, Automations |
| Fleet | `#area-fleet` | Environments, Drift, Spoke operations |
| Audit | `#area-audit` | Hash chain, Platform status |

Older screen hashes resolve through the engine's redirect table to their area
and tab. For example, `#s08-staged-run` opens Packaging / Timeline,
`#rm09-recalls` opens Releases / Recall, and `#s16-approvals-board` opens
Change requests / Approvals. `#s13-fleet-overview` intentionally opens the live
Command Center / Overview; Example fleet remains a separate explicit tab.

`#s01-intake/<sessionId>` opens Work Intake on that planning session. The
console reads `GET /v1/planning-sessions/{id}` and its events, and reports when
the session is unavailable. It writes this hash once a session exists.
`scripts/demo-seed.sh` prints navigation links after seeding.

Run `pnpm --dir web docs:navigation` after changing area or tab names.
`pnpm --dir web check:source` rejects stale documentation.
